title: bidens triplinervia var. hirtella
intro: Bidens triplinervia var. hirtella, commonly known as rough-stemmed beggar-ticks, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Bidens triplinervia var. hirtella include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve wound healing, and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may help to reduce pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress.
